'''Star Tours Flight 1115''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1M at 1215 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1310.
